title: Cohomology of site-perfect field duals
statement: Let $\ell$ be prime, $\Lambda=\mathbf F_\ell$, and $T$ a scheme, and $C\in D(T_{et},\Lambda)$ [def-weil-pbc-derived-categories]. Assume that an etale covering $\{U_j\to T\}$ makes $C|_{U_j}$ isomorphic to a bounded complex of coefficient sheaves, each term a retract of some finite constant free sheaf $\Lambda_{U_j}^{m}$. This is the ordinary etale predicate DerivedCategory.IsSitePerfect, with no global bound or invertibility assumption. Then for every integer $q$ there is an isomorphism of sheaves $H^q(R\mathcal Hom_\Lambda(C,\Lambda_T))\simeq\mathcal Hom_\Lambda(H^{-q}(C),\Lambda_T)$, where the two Hom operations are the derived and ordinary internal Hom of coefficient-module sheaves.
